frozen_request_schema: frozen_prediction_request_v1: endpoint_id, dataset_id, checkpoint{path,sha256}, protocol{path,sha256}, image_manifest{path,sha256}, image_dir, source_sha256 for the four inference/archive modules. The image manifest is an ordered JSON list of id/file_name/width/height/sha256.
before_inference: Verify actual checkpoint, protocol, image-manifest and local source content against fixed hashes. Bind exact package versions, critical installed Ultralytics source hashes, device/runtime flags, ordered image metadata and content hashes. Verify every image byte hash and header dimensions before model loading.
inference: Use the already verified FixedSquarePredictor and explicit32-image slicing, including the final remainder. Class-aware ten-class NMS and original protocol settings are unchanged. Obtain model-input shape/dtype/device from a forward hook. Classify on_predict_batch_start/on_predict_batch_end inputs separately from setup/warmup probes. Require exactly one float32[B,3,640,640] actual forward per committed batch.
integrity: Verify active-batch image bytes both before and after inference. Recheck all image hashes and checkpoint/protocol/manifest/local-source hashes before completion. Execution journals preserve started/finished/failed status and actual traces separately from immutable prediction storage. Changed input bytes fail even when an archive was previously complete.
resume: Verify existing archive, skip committed batches and append only pending whole batches. A complete archive is verified without loading the model or running inference. A positive max-new-batches is a graceful technical batch limit and does not finalize incomplete predictions. The CLI exposes no accuracy-based stopping or selection.
synthetic_evidence: 33 generated unlabeled images and existing preflight smoke checkpoint on CPU. Deliberately interrupt after the first32-image durable commit, resume only image33, then verify completed-archive access performs no model load or forward. Compare all37 archive artifact files against an uninterrupted run: every byte matches. All5577 predictions retained. Changed generated-image bytes are rejected. Checkpoint unchanged.
runtime_detail: The pinned Ultralytics CPU select_device helper sets torch threads to8 after the initial2-thread request; the recorded runtime correctly captures the actual8 threads. This is synthetic integration validation, not a latency benchmark. Deterministic algorithms use the pinned library warn-only setting, which is recorded rather than described as a universal determinism guarantee.
expected_test_interruption: The test-only callback intentionally raises SyntheticInterruption after durable batch0; this is a planned fault-injection fixture, not an unreported experimental failure. Temporary synthetic fixtures contain execution journals; no real data or model results are modified.
limits: CPU synthetic proof does not establish GPU bitwise reproducibility, actual GPU warmup trace behavior, full real-dataset correctness or scientific model performance. Validate GPU behavior once a GPU is available without interfering with active training. Freeze and audit all48 endpoint hashes after all training; then run every fixed native/common metric, preserve both KITTI variants and all outcomes. Native BDD final evaluation and roster orchestration/scoring still need integration.
